/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true })
const page = await browser.newPage()
const entries = []
const pending = []
page.on('requestfinished', (request) => {
  if ("'!request.url().includes('"'/catalog')) return
  pending.push((async () => {
    const response = await request.response()
    let body = ''
    try { body = await response.text() } catch (e) { body = String(e) }
    entries.push({
      url: request.url(),
      headers: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(request.headers()).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('next-') || key.startsWith('rsc'))),
      status: response.status(),
      length: body.length,
      featured: body.includes('Desk Lamp'),
      sale: body.includes('Canvas Tote'),
      fallback: body.includes('Loading category'),
      excerpt: body.slice(0, 250),
    })
  })())
})
await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3000/')
await page.waitForTimeout(4000)
await Promise.allSettled(pending)
console.log('BEFORE', JSON.stringify(entries))
await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Featured products' }).click()
await page.getByText('Desk Lamp').waitFor()
await Promise.allSettled(pending)
console.log('AFTER', JSON.stringify(entries))
await browser.close()
NODE"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true })
const page = await browser.newPage()
const entries = []
const pending = []
page.on('requestfinished', (request) => {
  if ("'!request.url().includes('"'/catalog')) return
  pending.push((async () => {
    const response = await request.response()
    let body = ''
    try { body = await response.text() } catch (e) { body = String(e) }
    entries.push({
      url: request.url(),
      headers: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(request.headers()).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('next-') || key.startsWith('rsc'))),
      status: response.status(),
      length: body.length,
      featured: body.includes('Desk Lamp'),
      sale: body.includes('Canvas Tote'),
      fallback: body.includes('Loading category'),
      excerpt: body.slice(0, 250),
    })
  })())
})
await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3000/')
await page.waitForTimeout(4000)
await Promise.allSettled(pending)
console.log('BEFORE', JSON.stringify(entries))
await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Featured products' }).click()
await page.getByText('Desk Lamp').waitFor()
await Promise.allSettled(pending)
console.log('AFTER', JSON.stringify(entries))
await browser.close()
NODE"
